Use the suno-band-profile-manager skill --headless:create. (No BMad install in this test folder; the default folders under docs/ are fine.)

```yaml
# Band Profile — Juniper Halloway
# Solo project: just me, a harmonium and a kitchen-table mic.

name: "Juniper Halloway"
version: 1
instrumental: false

genre: "chamber folk with harmonium drones"
mood: "hushed, wintry, patient"
language: English
reference_tracks:
  - "a harmonium recorded in a cold church hall, the voice right on the mic"

model_preference: "v6-mini"
tier: free

# NOTE: keep the harmonium dry and close; reverb turns it into a church organ.
style_baseline: >
  Chamber folk, solo female voice close to the mic, clear airy alto, harmonium
  drones under fingerpicked nylon-string guitar, slow 3/4 sway, dry intimate room,
  bowed cello swells on the last verse, no percussion, quiet and patient.
exclusion_defaults:
  - no drums
  - no autotune

vocal:
  gender: female
  tone: "clear, airy alto with a slight catch"
  delivery: "unhurried, almost spoken in the verses"
  energy: "low, steady"

sliders:
  weirdness: 40
  style_influence: 70

studio_preferences:
  bpm: 68
  key: "D minor"
  time_signature: "3/4"
```
rubric: docs/band-profiles/juniper-halloway.yaml exists with name "Juniper Halloway", tier free and model_preference v6-mini, and has no `sliders:` key and no `studio_preferences:` key (the Free tier can use neither).

Everything else survived verbatim: the saved profile still holds the comment line "# NOTE: keep the harmonium dry and close; reverb turns it into a church organ." and the header comment "# Solo project: just me, a harmonium and a kitchen-table mic.", the style_baseline text is unchanged, and the vocal block keeps gender female. No comment line was added that the input didn't have (reasons belong in the decision log).

The first staged draft is the input as given, sliders and studio_preferences included, so the validator reports the Free-tier conflict before anything is dropped.
Single write path: no Write or Edit tool call, and no shell redirection, sed or python write, targets docs/band-profiles/juniper-halloway.yaml; that file is created only by apply-profile.py --save.
docs/juniper-halloway-playlist.yaml exists with album "Juniper Halloway" and no tracks, and docs/band-profiles/drafts/juniper-halloway.yaml no longer exists.
